'''Pi-Lippa''' was an [[Alien/Legends|alien]] [[Slaver/Legends|enslaver]] who, for a [[Time/Legends|time]], acquired the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Shmi Skywalker Lars/Legends|Shmi Skywalker]] as property. Pi-Lippa taught Skywalker technical skills and intended to grant her freedom, however, the alien [[Death/Legends|died]] suddenly in approximately [[41 BBY/Legends|41 BBY]], shortly after the [[Reproduction/Legends|birth]] of Shmi's son [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin]]. Shmi was then sold to a [[Pi-Lippa's relative|relative]] of Pi-Lippa's, who did not honor the deceased's intentions.

==Biography==
[[File:ShmiSkywalkerLars-Databank.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Shmi Skywalker Lars, who was enslaved by Pi-Lippa.]]
Pi-Lippa was an [[Alien/Legends|alien]] [[Slaver/Legends|enslaver]]<ref name="CSWE" /> who, in [[67 BBY/Legends|67 BBY]],<ref name="Annual 2008">''[[Star Wars Annual 2008]]''</ref> acquired the [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Shmi Skywalker Lars/Legends|Shmi Skywalker]] as property. Pi-Lippa promised to grant Skywalker's freedom<ref name="Databank">{{DB|character|shmiskywalker|Skywalker, Shmi}}</ref> and went out of<ref name="Fact File">{{FactFile|70|SHM 1-4|Shmi Skywalker}}</ref> her<ref name="Insider's guide" /> way to teach Skywalker technical skills<ref name="Fact File" /> such as [[Computer/Legends|computer]] part maintenance<ref name="Adventures">[[Star Wars Adventures Magazine 8|''Star Wars Adventures Magazine'' 8]]</ref> so that she could remain independent once freed.<ref name="Secrets">''[[Secrets of Tatooine]]''</ref> Unfortunately for Skywalker,<ref name="Fact File" /> shortly after the [[Chosen One/Legends|miraculous]] [[Reproduction/Legends|birth]] of her son, [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]],<ref name="Secrets" /> in [[41 BBY/Legends|41 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> Pi-Lippa [[Death/Legends|died]] suddenly<ref name="Secrets" /> and unexpectedly before fulfilling her promise,<ref name="CSWE" /> devastating Shmi.<ref name="Fact File" /> 

The inheritors of Pi-Lippa's estate chose not to honor her commitment to Skywalker's freedom,<ref name="Fact File" /> and the Human was sold to a [[Pi-Lippa's relative|relative]] of Pi-Lippa,<ref name="CSWE" /> who did not want to grant Skywalker's freedom.<ref name="Rise and Fall">''[[The Rise and Fall of Darth Vader]]''</ref> The skills that Pi-Lippa taught Skywalker increased her value to her later enslavers,<ref name="Power">{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: Power of the Jedi|pack=Shmi Skywalker|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/POTJshmi.asp}}</ref> and she continued to apply them in her [[Local day/Legends|daily]] life<ref name="CSWE" /> on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Visual">''[[Star Wars: Episode I: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]],<ref name="CSWE" /> including her [[Standard day/Legends|nighttime]] work to earn additional [[Currency/Legends|currency]] by cleaning computer memory devices.<ref name="Adventures" /> Shmi also encouraged Anakin's interest in technology, believing that it could help liberate both of them.<ref name="Power" /> She was eventually freed<ref name="Databank" /> in [[26 BBY/Legends|26 BBY]]<ref name="Visual Guide">''[[Star Wars: The Ultimate Visual Guide]]'' states that [[Watto/Legends|Watto]] sold [[Shmi Skywalker Lars/Legends|Shmi Skywalker]] to [[Cliegg Lars/Legends|Cliegg Lars]] six years after he lost [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], the latter event having taken place in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] according to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''. Therefore, Shmi's freedom must have been granted in [[26 BBY/Legends|26 BBY]].</ref> after being purchased by the [[Moisture farmer/Legends|moisture farmer]] [[Cliegg Lars/Legends|Cliegg Lars]], who also [[Marriage/Legends|married]] her.<ref name="Databank" />

==Personality and traits==
Although an enslaver, Pi-Lippa was a kind individual who intended to grant Shmi Skywalker's freedom<ref name="Databank" /> and taught her the skills needed for independent living.<ref name="Secrets" />

==Skills and abilities==
Pi-Lippa was able to teach Shmi Skywalker technical skills,<ref name="Fact File" /> including computer part maintenance.<ref name="Secrets" />

==Behind the scenes==
Pi-Lippa was first mentioned in the [[1999]] reference book [[Star Wars: Episode I: The Visual Dictionary|''Star Wars: Episode I The Visual Dictionary'']], written by [[David West Reynolds (real person)|David West Reynolds]].<ref name="Visual" /> The [[2001]] sourcebook ''[[Secrets of Tatooine]]''<ref name="Secrets" /> and the [[2003]] magazine [[Star Wars Adventures Magazine 8|''Star Wars Adventures Magazine'' 8]] use he/him pronouns for Pi-Lippa,<ref name="Adventures" /> while numerous other sources use she/her pronouns.<ref name="CSWE" /><ref name="Insider's guide" /><ref name="Fact File" /><ref name="Rise">''[[The Rise and Fall of Darth Vader]]''</ref>

Additionally, ''Star Wars Adventures Magazine'' 8 states that Pi-Lippa's relative to whom Skywalker was sold was the [[Toydarian/Legends|Toydarian]] [[Watto/Legends|Watto]],<ref name="Adventures" /> in contradiction to other sources, which state that Shmi was sold to others before eventually being acquired by the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Gardulla Besadii the Elder/Legends|Gardulla Besadii the Elder]] and then lost in a bet to Watto.<ref name="Fact File" /><ref name="Secrets" /><ref name="Rise" /> In the case of contradictions this article follows the facts established by the majority of sources.
